# Official Story Assistance fixtures

These are offline copies of the self-contained Twine Cookbook CSS selector
examples downloaded on 2026-07-25. Runtime tests never fetch the network.
The Twine Cookbook identifies its work and examples as [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://www.twinery.org/cookbook/index.html#license); the embedded story-format/runtime notices remain in each copied HTML file.

load them from disk and use the generated TwinePlayer bridge in an offline
browser context.
